headline: HOMEBODY: the player can order the romance
lede: The little lot always had a mind of its own — bonds climbed on chat, spats cracked them, cold wars froze them. Now the commands are yours: C says the kind thing to whoever is within arm's reach (Space/A ride the compliment where nothing else is near), at FAMILY tier it deepens into affection — hearts, chord, double pay — and X hurls an insult that cuts the bond and sets the grudge, with the human way back still the only way back.

notes.text: #2131 shipped: coo +3, FAMILY-tier affection +6 with its own chord and pink hearts, insult −4 that starts the cold war on command; shared 8s cooldown rides the hash so a frantic thumb cannot flatten the meter, and seeds stay byte-exact. peoplecheck 185/185 (+23 gates, reach mutant 172/13 proven red); real Chrome drive proves the cut, the deepening and the far-apart Space doctrine.

The law caught the test, not the other way round: insulting a partner whose temper is UP mends instantly (−4+6) — a drive gate that assumed otherwise was rewritten to park tempers neutral. The game was right.

#2039 verified closed: the tick-aware resume budgets shipped by #2116, and the exact nightly shapes (comet 376u-in-window, blob match-won-mid-leg) are pinned 15/15 in watchbudgetcheck plus blob/comet watchcheck pilots green at 8x/16x/32x CPU throttle, six runs, zero page errors.
Short Order Shout's cool-the-pan ink (#7fd4e8) confirmed live in the deployed chunk on jalfern.com — the prod verification deferred from an earlier lane now lands on #2113.
